title: agropyron ruthenicum
intro: Agropyron ruthenicum, commonly known as Elymus ruthenicus, is a species of grass within the family Poaceae. It is a perennial grass native to Eastern Europe and parts of Asia, and is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various health issues, such as wounds, skin conditions, and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of Elymus ruthenicus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
